stage: wasm32 emitter written in A0 (compiler/emit_wasm.a0; entry emitwasmio in compiler/boot.a0), the port of src/wasm.ts
method: a0c-stage1 (the bootstrap C seed) compiles the closure of emitwasmio in chunks; clang builds that C into a0w. Each program is emitted a chunk of functions at a time, as the checked tables of the TypeScript front end in the A0 front end layout (mode 2) and, where every function fits the A0 front end (16384 source bytes a chunk), as formatted source through the A0 lexer, parser and checker (mode 1); a0w links the chunks into the module (mode 3). Both are compared byte for byte with src/wasm.ts on the unoptimized program.
